international.title: Rosebank-supporting MPs warn PM blocking oilfield would mean ‘lights out for Labour in Scotland’
international.summary: After nearly 100 colleagues called on Andy Burnham to block the oilfield, as many as 80 Labour MPs are planning to urge the opposite Dozens of Labour MPs in favour of Rosebank are putting pressure on the prime minister not to block the North Sea oilfield, warning that doing so could spell “lights out for Labour in Scotland”. As many as 80 pro-drilling MPs are considering writing their own letter to Andy Burnham after nearly 100 of their colleagues called on the prime minister not to allow the project to proceed . Scottish Labour leader Michael Marra has also reiterated his support for Rosebank, cautioning that “working-class people in vocational jobs” were threatened by the decline of the North Sea basin.
